seoFaq.q1: How do I convert a PDF to Markdown without losing formatting?
seoFaq.a1: Upload your PDF to our PDF to Markdown converter and click convert. AI OCR extracts headings, paragraphs, tables, and images in the right reading order and rebuilds them as a clean .md file. Your Markdown keeps the document structure and is ready for blogs, documentation sites, and static site generators.
seoFaq.q2: Can I convert a scanned PDF to Markdown?
seoFaq.a2: Yes. The converter has built-in AI OCR that reads text from scanned pages and image-based PDFs, including handwritten notes and stamps. A photographed contract or a scanned textbook page becomes searchable, editable Markdown — most converters can't handle scanned files, ours was built for it.
seoFaq.q3: Is the PDF to Markdown converter free?
seoFaq.a3: Yes. Every new user gets free conversion credits to use on PDF to Markdown conversion. Each conversion costs a small number of credits based on pages, so you can try it free before buying more. No subscription, pay as you go.
seoFaq.q4: What can I do with Markdown converted from a PDF?
seoFaq.a4: Markdown is perfect for blogs, docs sites, and static page builders like Hugo, Jekyll, or Next.js. After downloading the .md file, paste it into any Markdown editor, CMS, or Git repository — headings, tables, and images carry over and stay editable.
seoFaq.q5: Are images and tables preserved when converting PDF to Markdown?
seoFaq.a5: Yes. The converter extracts images from your PDF and serves them with stable URLs, and tables are rebuilt in Markdown table syntax. You can also set a page range (e.g. "1,3,5-8") to convert only the pages you need.
